name: Follow-Up Sequence

parameters.jsCode:
// After Twilio fires, $json is the SMS response — trace back to the lead
const lead = $('Filter & Build Messages').item.json;
return [{ json: {
  leadId: lead.leadId,
  phone: lead.phone,
  source: lead.source,
  firstName: lead.firstName,
  lastName: lead.lastName,
  email: lead.email,
  address: lead.address,
  serviceNeeded: lead.serviceNeeded,
  status: lead.newStatus,
  followUpCount: lead.followUpCount,
  logChannel: lead.logChannel,
  logDirection: lead.logDirection,
  logHandler: lead.logHandler,
  logSummary: lead.logSummary,
  logNotes: lead.logNotes
}}];

parameters.content: Fallback nurture sequence for leads that were NOT auto-scheduled (auto-scheduling failed, or no service detail yet). Runs daily at 9 AM ET, sends Day 1/3/7 SMS, updates status/Follow-up Count via CRM Adapter. Most leads never reach this workflow since Form Capture auto-books them immediately.

description: Daily 9 AM ET follow-up sequence. Sends Day 1/3/7 SMS to New/Contacted leads via Twilio, then updates status and Follow-up Count via CRM Adapter.
